subject: System Design
title: Service Discovery
description: A quick win: understand Service Discovery.

hook.text: The orders service needs to call the payments service. But its IP address changed after a deploy. Where is it now?

buildup.text: Service discovery maintains a registry of all services and their network locations.

discovery.text: Services register themselves on startup. Clients query the registry to find the current address of a service.

twist.text: If the registry is down, no service can find any other service. The registry is now a critical dependency.

climax.text: Kubernetes solves this with DNS-based service discovery. Each service gets a stable DNS name that routes automatically.

punchline.text: Services need to find each other — discovery makes it automatic.

quiz.question: What problem does service discovery solve?
options: Finding the current network address of services that move between deploys
